app.name: Light Dey?
app.tagline: Is there light? Tell your neighbours.

thanks.on: Thank you! Your neighbours will be happy.
thanks.off: NEPA has done it again. Thanks for letting us know.

errors.cooldown: Thanks! You can report here again in {mins} min.

errors.offline: No network right now. Please try again.
errors.bot: We could not confirm you are a person. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

offline.banner: No network. You can still report: we will send it when you are back online.
offline.queued: Saved on your phone. We will send it when the network comes back.
offline.sent: Back online! Your saved report was sent.

page.title: No network
page.body: Light Dey? could not reach the internet, and this page was not saved on your phone yet. Reports you make will be sent when the network is back.

install.title: Put Light Dey? on your home screen
install.body: It opens faster, and you can report even when your network is bad.
install.ios: On iPhone: tap the Share button, then Add to Home Screen.

spots.title: Your spots
spots.full: You can save up to 3 spots. Remove one to add another.

welcome.title: Light dey? Tell your neighbours.
welcome.body: Report in two taps whether there is light in your area. Together we see the real picture: when light comes, when it goes, and how many hours your area really gets.

spot.noResults: No area found. Try another spelling, or browse by state.
spot.noAreasYet: We have not opened {lga} yet. Light Dey? starts in Abuja and Lagos, and more places are coming.
